///
/// 默认值对应非负连续整数的 f32 精度边界；不表示更大的整数一概不可表示。
/// 当前发布值：恢复前沿用逐项 f32 结果，恢复后由宽精度历史得出。
/// 持续累积各输入的 f64 表示，恢复前也同步推进。
/// 任意一次非有限候选后即置位；后续累计保持使用宽精度恢复分支。
/// 读取当前 f64 累计历史；该值仍可能非有限，也未经过几何预算检查。
/// 单个轴向大小的上限。
/// 累计大小及坐标绝对值的上限，不是可耗尽的剩余额度。
/// 被拒绝的尝试值，保留 NaN 或无穷等异常数值。
/// 本次比较采用的数值上限。
/// 有界请求值；直接构造时由调用方维护预算前提。
/// 保留无界请求，后续生成的成品几何仍需预算准入。
/// 有限且落在闭区间 `[0, max_axis_extent]` 时返回 `extent` 原值，否则返回拒绝数值。
/// 还原请求参数；无界分支返回正无穷，不能据此把它当作已准入的发布大小。

semantic_contracts.recovery: finite candidate wins unchanged; otherwise finite_geometry maps NaN to0 and clamps to±f32MAX. This is recovery, not budget/precision/source/clip/memory admission.
semantic_contracts.accumulation: exact f64 history updates every call. Any nonfinite candidate sets recovered permanently; subsequent publications use that history rather than the saturated f32 value. Copy duplicates current state. exact is finite-precision history, not arbitrary precision.
semantic_contracts.budget: new requires finite axis>0 and finite cumulative>=axis. Extents use closed[0,cap]; coordinates use signed closed[-cumulative,+cumulative]. Each check copies immutable caps, not a consumable quota.
semantic_contracts.arithmetic: checked_add first admits both operands, compares f64 sum, then admits converted f32. scale admits axis input even count0, compares f64 product then admits f32. Frame endpoints are ordinary f32 additions; only listed resulting fields are checked.
semantic_contracts.request_metadata: +infinity is accepted only as Unbounded request metadata. request_extent returns it; directly constructed Bounded is not automatically validated. subtract first admits consumed in both branches, clamps bounded difference at0, does not revalidate existing Bounded.
semantic_contracts.publication: C02 first obtains Ready layout and successful font fence, calls admission259–264, builds rich artifact270+ or plain artifact295+ only afterward. Failed admission returns Failed before artifact construction.
semantic_contracts.diagnostic: publication borrows layout, mutably borrows session only for this call. Error converts both source endpoints to u32 or drops range; work units are saturating lines+boxes. C04 reject updates C05 geometry rejection_count(saturating) and last receipt, then GeometryTooLarge. Fallback count is separately updated by record_layout_error.
semantic_contracts.limits: Only explicitly enumerated widths/heights/font/line metrics/frames/baseline/advances/boxes/border are checked; not all metadata, semantic source correspondence, clipping or container inclusion.
semantic_contracts.tests: 7 numeric unit tests plus1 direct admission fixture. Fixture verifies GeometryTooLarge and receipt owner/range/values; no artifact builder invocation. Actual ordering is C02 code evidence, not test execution.
